references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical heavy four-legged stone beast, squat broad body, blunt mineral horns and tall angular thorn-like back plates, ochre mineral seams, heavy blunt feet, small armored head. Charging wedge silhouette; no gore. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. Keep the approved BLUE illuminated mineral seams as well as ochre cracks. The approved image outranks any conflicting written color description. CORRECTION: Rebuild layout as six SMALL separate figures in 3 columns and 2 rows. Every head points UPPER RIGHT; rear feet point LOWER LEFT. Camera sees rump and dorsal plates. In final pose expose back of skull ONLY, hide face, muzzle and glowing eyes completely behind the head. Final torso and side of skull TOUCH GROUND, four feet extended sideways without carrying weight. Tilt the back plates sideways with the torso. Never substitute a front-facing crouch. Same anatomical scale, no growing figures, no overlap. Generous blank margins.
input.referenceConsumption: agy receives all named image references; creatures always include original approved Covenant creature source; Grok wrapper consumes first identity image only, Covenant style block is textual

arguments.Prompt: A 3x2 grid character sprite animation sheet on a solid pure flat vivid magenta background (#FF00FF). Exactly 6 sequential collapse animation frames arranged in 3 columns and 2 rows, showing the exact magical heavy four-legged stone beast from reference-1.png and reference-2.png collapsing to the ground. Consistent rear-right three-quarter perspective (North-East, 55-degree high orthographic angle, camera viewing the rump, back surfaces, and dorsal plates; head pointed diagonally away toward upper-right). Frame 1 (top-left): Ready quadrupedal stance facing diagonally away. Frame 2 (top-center): Knees bending, legs folding, chest lowering. Frame 3 (top-right): Belly and chest very close to ground. Frame 4 (bottom-left): Torso tipping sideways, angular thorn back plates tilting. Frame 5 (bottom-center): Chest, belly, and head touching the ground. Frame 6 (bottom-right): Fully still, lying flat on its side, torso and skull side touching ground with face hidden away, dorsal plates tilted sideways, four legs relaxed sideways. Stylized painted game concept art, stone carapace with glowing blue seams and ochre cracks, identical anatomical scale across all 6 figures, generous empty magenta margins, no text, no frame lines, no floor.
